literal_meaning: মন এবং প্রাণে (with mind and soul)
similar_in_english: from the bottom of my heart
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমি মনেপ্রাণে চাই তুমি দেশে থাকো।
example_sentences_in_english: I wholeheartedly want you to stay in the country.
He works with heart and soul.
note: This idiom emphasizes deep emotional commitment, common in Bengali literature and speech.
